refs.purpose: The substitution table: which tools have a lower-cost replacement, the replacement's exact `tool_id`, how ports and parameters map, and the opt-out conditions that keep the original.
refs.verification: Promote after a run on an IWC workflow with a FastQC step emits a replace-tool entry pinned to iuc/falco, and the update chain applies it, implements it, and passes the carried-forward tests.

refs.purpose: Record each swap or kept original as a decision, and a matching step whose evidence is too thin to judge as an open entry.
refs.verification: Promote after a reviewer reads a run's decisions and can reverse a swap or confirm a kept original without re-deriving the opt-out.

refs.purpose: Input contract: read step tool ids, settings, connections, input formats, and tests from the existing-workflow summary.

produces.description: Reviewable change-set in the same entry format [[interview-to-galaxy-workflow-changeset]] emits: one `replace-tool` or `change-parameter` entry per proposed efficiency edit, each anchored to an existing step, preceded by a summary of the levers consulted and the matching steps left unchanged with the reason. The human approval point before [[apply-galaxy-workflow-changeset]] touches the workflow.
Carried obligations ledger re-emitted by this step: a decision for every matching step, swapped or kept, and every other entry passed through with its provenance intact.

consumes.description: Structured summary of the existing workflow from [[summarize-galaxy-workflow]]: each step's `tool_id`, `tool_state`, connections and outputs, the workflow inputs' formats, the edge graph, and any existing tests. The anchor set every change-set entry addresses.
Carried obligations ledger [[open-requirements-ledger]]: the run's open, resolved, and surrendered entries with their provenance. Absent on the first Mold of a run; start an empty one.
